sections.shortTitle: Development of Industries Government Control Act 1949
sections.description:
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERN MENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
ACT NO. XIII OF 1949
[21st March, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
development of industries under (Subs. by A.O.,
1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".)[Government Control].
SCHEDULE
1. Arms and Munitions of War.
2. Cement and Cement Products,
3. Edible Oil, Hydrogenated or
otherwise.
4. Electrical communications and
Broadcasting equipment.
5. Electricity, including
hydro-electric power.
6. Electrical equipment,
appliances and goods.
7. Glass and Ceramics.
8. Heavy Chemicals.
9. Iron and Steel.
10. Machine-tools,
Precision-tools, Gauges and Workshop equipment.
11. Manufactures of Heavy
Engineering Industry.
12. Minerals including salt and
coal.
13. Non-ferrous metals and alloy
manufactures.
14. Paper, Cardboard and Pulp.
15. Petroleum and mineral oils.
16. Pharmaceuticals, drugs, and
light chemicals.
17. Power and industrial alcohol.
18. Preserved and prepared foods.
19. Products of carbonisation
Industry.
20. Rubber manufactures.
21. Scientific and Mathematical
instruments,
22. Sea fish and its products.
23. Ships, barges, river-boats
and lighters.
24. Sugar.
25. Tanned leather and leather
goods.
26. Textiles-Cotton, Woollen,
Jute, Silk and Rayon.
27. Tobacco.

sections.shortTitle: Development of Industries Government Control Act 1949
sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERN MENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
ACT NO. XIII OF 1949
[21st March, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
development of industries under (Subs. by A.O.,
1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".)[Government Control].
1. Short title extent and commencement.-(1) This Act may be called
the Development of Industries (Subs. by A.O., 1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal
Control".) [Government
Control] Act, 1949. ;
(Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform)
Ordinance, 1960 (21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch., for the original sub-section
(2) (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).) [(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Development of Industries Government Control Act 1949
sections.description:
Definitions

THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERN MENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
ACT NO. XIII OF 1949
[21st March, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
development of industries under (Subs. by A.O.,
1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".)[Government Control].
2. Definitions. In this Act unless there is anything repugnant in
the subject or context,-
(a) "industry" means
any industry engaged in the manufacture or processing of specified goods or
commodities and includes any industry ancillary to such an industry, and
"industries" shall be construed accordingly;
(b) "specified" means
specified in the Schedule to this Act.
(Clause (c) ins. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and
Sch.)[(c) "appropriate
Government" means, in relation to arms and munitions of war, minerals
necessary for the generation of nuclear energy and petro leum and mineral oils,
the Central Government and, in relation to other industries, the Provincial
Government.]

3. Declaration. It is hereby declared that the development under (Subs. ibid.,

THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERN MENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
ACT NO. XIII OF 1949
[21st March, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
development of industries under (Subs. by A.O.,
1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".)[Government Control].
3A. Power to regulate industry. (S. 3A ins.
by the Development of Industries (Federal Control) Amendment Act, 1950 (44 of
1950), s. 2.)[In pursuance of
the declaration made in the last preceding section the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch, for

sections.shortTitle: Development of Industries Government Control Act 1949
sections.description:
Rules to be subject to previous publication

THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERNMENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIES (GOVERN MENT CONTROL) ACT, 1949
ACT NO. XIII OF 1949
[21st March, 1949]
An Act to make provision for certain matters connected with the
development of industries under (Subs. by A.O.,
1964 Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal Control".)[Government Control].
5. Rules to be subject to previous publication.-(1) All rules made
under this Act shall be subject to the condition of previous publication and
the date to be speci fied under clause (3) of section 23 of the General Clauses
Act, 1897, shall not be less than one month from the date on which the draft of
the proposed rules was published, X of 1897.
(2) All such rules shall be
published in the official Gazette and shall, unless some later date is
appointed in such rules, (For the Development of Industries Rules, 1950, see Gaz. of
P., 1951, Pt. I, sec. I, pp. 85-88.)
come into force on the date of such publication.
